notes.title: Plans for game improvements
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451542/68e3fc65ac2caab8b7cdc0b7a4bebc80dd4e75a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The following improvements were completed in the previous update.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Addition of a penalty feature to online battles[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Addition of a skip battle feature to story mode[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Addition of a feature to adjust text display speed in story mode[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Additionally, the following updates are planned for future patches:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Adding an option to forfeit online Koi-Koi and Holo Awase matches.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adding an option to customize the number of rounds during single play and lobby matches for Koi-Koi, Flower Awase, and Oicho-Kabu.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adding Function to change the time limit in Room Match.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adding Expanded functionality for Bento Creation Mode.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Finally, we plan to release the second paid DLC featuring "Hoshimachi Suisei" and "Tokoyami Towa" next Tuesday, September 30th (JST). We hope you'll enjoy this as well. We will continue making improvements to ensure everyone can enjoy a more comfortable play experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to your continued support of "Holo's Hanafuda".[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Improvement Patch Released! & Reviews exceed 100!
notes.notes: [h2][b]■Improvement patch now available. Thank you for over 100 reviews![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45451542/c92bd9f807cad3b8d838c07772e920a5c8b1470b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of “Holo's Hanafuda”![/p][p]Since release, we've been incredibly grateful to see so many people playing the game and receiving your supportive messages and suggestions for improvement.[/p][p]Your reviews, community hub posts, livestreams, and social media shares have been a tremendous encouragement to the entire development team.[/p][p][/p][p]We have now released the following improvement patch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]・Added an option to skip a losing match in Adventure Mode.[/b][/p][p][b]・Added an option to adjust the text display speed in Adventure Mode.[/b][/p][p][b]・Added penalty functionality when disconnecting in the middle of an online match.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, the first DLC is currently [b]10% OFF for a limited time[/b], so please consider purchasing it if you're interested[b].[/b][/p]

notes.title: Release of improvement and bug fix patches!
notes.notes:
・Added an option to skip a losing match in Adventure Mode.
・Added an option to adjust the text display speed in Adventure Mode.

・Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Plans for game improvements
notes.notes: [p]We plan to release improvement patches for each platform in the order they are completed between the end of August and mid-September.[/p][p]The initial patches will include the following updates:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Addition of a penalty feature to online battles[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Addition of a skip battle feature to story mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Addition of a feature to adjust text display speed in story mode[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Additionally, the following updates are planned for future patches:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Add a feature to change the number of rounds in “Koikoi” and ‘Hanaawase’[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Finally, we plan to release the first paid DLC around noon today.[/p][p]We hope you will enjoy this as well.[/p][p]We will continue to make improvements to ensure a more enjoyable experience for all players.[/p][p]We look forward to your continued support of “Holo's Hanafuda.”[/p]
